name: vibedev_rail_project_context
content: - Pass this repo_path to run_coding_task so the coding engine starts in the selected project directory inside the shadow workspace.
- Do not use delegation_files as the implementation working-directory mechanism; run_coding_task owns the repo cwd.
- Use delegation_shell/delegation_files after the first run_coding_task call only for verification, git/build checks, or when run_coding_task reports missing context.

- Verify file changes against the `real_working_dir` returned in the run_coding_task result — NOT your own shell/repo root. delegation_shell/delegation_files are rooted at the service repository and will NOT see the project working directory, so a file run_coding_task wrote can look "missing" if you check there.
- Keep new runs and follow-ups scoped to this VibeDev project unless the user explicitly switches projects.

- This run was started with `@vibedev` from an ordinary chat turn, not from the VibeDev cockpit: there is no live preview pane or diff viewer attached to the conversation, so state your outcome explicitly in the run result.

metadata.description: Mode-neutral prose of the `@vibedev` chat rail's VibeDev project-context block, rendered for build and Discuss runs alike. Guidance that holds for only one mode does NOT belong here: it lives in vibedev_rail_project_context_build / vibedev_rail_project_context_plan, which Rust selects by the run's mode and renders above this prose. The machine-read lines of the block (`VibeDev project:`, `run_coding_task repo_path:`) are assembled in Rust and deliberately NOT stored here, because `agents/runtime.rs` string-matches them back out and a prompt-store edit must not be able to break that contract silently.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.1.0: The build-only line (`Build runs must invoke run_coding_task before any shell/file pre-inspection…`) moved to vibedev_rail_project_context_build, so a Discuss run no longer needs it rewritten after render. v1.0.0: Initial `@vibedev` rail project-context prose, lifted from the cockpit composer.
